headline: Normal 1Password app lock; broker healthy
summary: 1Password locked at 00:55:32 Eastern on October 21. The broker and keepalive remained healthy. No software repair is warranted. Unlocking 1Password and any required native consent remain Taylor’s actions.
cause: The bounded timestamped parser found a genuine lock event at 2026-10-21T04:55:32.443+00:00, matching saved keepalive state. This is an app lock, with no evidence of a broker crash, stale watchdog or parser fault. The reason for the lock is not established. Both successful account calls at 00:53 Eastern predated the lock and do not prove current authorization.
resolution: No implementation changes, installation, restart or additional authorization wake were warranted or performed. Lock suppression is operating as intended. README.md links the verified incident and its limits; no candidate fix was required.
verification: parser-check.json confirms readable logs and matching timestamped lock state without retaining raw lines. deployed-hashes.json verifies worker/keepalive source and deployed hashes, running keepalive hash, build stamp and signature. baseline.json and final-status.json show broker PID/session 1213, /dev/ttys000 and keepalive PID 1214 preserved, a heartbeat advancing from 00:55:58 to 00:56:19 Eastern, and unchanged historical account status while locked. python-tests.json and broker-tests.json record 44 passing isolated Python tests; node-tests.json records 37 passing tests. metadata-smoke.json records wrapper --version exit 0 with stdout/stderr discarded; authenticated checks were skipped while locked. chat-check.json verifies the exact title, dotfiles directory, Pinned section, strongest advertised supported model gpt-6-astra and high reasoning.
activation: Existing signed service remains running unchanged. Nothing is staged and no activation is needed. Unlock 1Password when access is needed and complete native consent if requested; recovery owns the authorization wake.
limitations: Current account authorization was not tested while locked. Version success establishes wrapper responsiveness, not vault authorization. The exact app-lock trigger and physical notification click behavior were not tested. No Computer Use or live Claude tests were performed.
docs: Reviewed src/onepassword/README.md, src/onepassword/agent-contract.md and src/onepassword/autofixes/AGENTS.md. Updated README.md with the October 21 evidence and authorization limits. The shared contract and autofix guidance already cover normal app locks; no contract edit or sync was needed.
